focusedDiagnostics.controlProvenance: Copied pre-remediation compiled entries and worker, with current external platform admission modules. The control is not a pristine historical checkout.
focusedDiagnostics.prototypeProvenance: Ignored copies of compiled bundles with the named perturbations; no prototype source/build archives retained. A source SHA alone does not reconstruct these variants.
focusedDiagnostics.method: Two reversed process populations, native isolated loopback, two drivers, identical response hashes. String arrivals: 30 s warmup and 60 s at 10k offered RPS. Concurrency probes: 10 s warmup and 30 s measurement.

variants.aligned: Measured public response path at the implementation commit
variants.noTail: Skip encoding an empty final Unicode tail; cost probe only
variants.noCount: Omit progressive byte-limit accounting; correctness-reducing cost probe, not a shipping candidate
variants.noBoundary: Return render completion directly and unlink cancellation early; loses asynchronous error recovery and cancellation guarantees, not a shipping candidate
variants.thin: Replace the async producer completion frame with promise success/error continuations while retaining cleanup
variants.noEvents: Await start/complete event emission only when it returns a promise

focusedDiagnostics.conclusion: Matched Node string and Bun string checks did not reproduce their historical-chart regressions. Bun streaming retained an approximately 3% direct-path deficit. Completion handling contributes; the remaining cost is not fully isolated. No probe was adopted.

bunChunkedTransfer.prototypeProvenance: Ignored copied adapter bundles modify response delivery only; authored and compiled components are unchanged. The source SHA alone cannot reconstruct these uncommitted prototypes.
bunChunkedTransfer.method: Two reversed populations per comparison, fresh service/worker/two drivers per variant, 10 s warmup and 15 s each at concurrency 16 and 128 on native isolated loopback; matching decoded response hashes.

variants.yieldfirst: Same queue, await setImmediate after first nonempty byte enqueue
variants.timerfirst: Same queue, await setTimeout(0) after first nonempty byte enqueue
variants.all: Native Bun direct stream, shared Unicode-safe encoder, flush(true) after every nonempty write; rejects subsequent pull production once started

wire.pendingTailFraming: chunked; head arrives before the 40 ms gated tail
wire.explicitHeader: Does not override native Content-Length for immediately completed output
wire.deferredStart: Deferring all production alone does not force chunking

bunChunkedTransfer.rejectedDirectFirst: Two multi-process preflight attempts failed with HPE_INVALID_CONSTANT. A concurrent request probe observed duplicate terminating chunks. Sequential requests passed. Root cause is not established beyond this prototype.
bunChunkedTransfer.directBackpressure: Native HTTP slow-reader probes stopped production and explicit cancellation unwound before scope release. A JavaScript-reader probe buffered approximately 8 MiB despite a requested 32 KiB bound; this blocks general adoption.
bunChunkedTransfer.conclusion: All valid forced-chunking candidates reduced throughput in both populations. No runtime change adopted; full accepted baseline and public chart data remain unchanged.

correctness.controlled: Node and Bun, string and stream browser contracts passed

clientRefresh.scope: Node production browser contracts and desktop/mobile presentation parity

retention.note: Only bounded summaries and chart data are retained in Git; raw capture hashes identify local measurement inputs.

arrivalWarmup.method: Thirty seconds at target rate per fresh process population. Counts total both drivers across both populations. Response p99 bounds span individual driver percentiles in milliseconds. Warmup is excluded from measured arrival charts.

clientRelativeComparison.referenceAggregation: Equal-weight geometric mean of each reference framework after/before ratio, separately for each statistic.
clientRelativeComparison.formula: relative change = (Exact after / Exact before) / reference ratio - 1

exploratoryMeanBootstrap.limitation: Resamples shared round indexes within each run, with independent draws for before and after. Assumes exchangeable rounds and cannot identify code causality or correct systematic host effects.

limitations: References did not move uniformly. This is a sensitivity analysis, not proof of a common host scaling factor.
With 30 samples, nearest-rank P99 is the maximum and P95 is the second-largest observation.
Tail width is percentile minus median. Normalized percentile movement is a different quantity.

methodology.method: Historical modules substituted at Vite load from git source. Current transpilation verified against installed dist. Same compiler, dependencies, application, configuration and SSR document.
methodology.order: All six permutations of before, after, and Svelte repeat in balanced order. Second population swaps before/after replay ports.
methodology.delivery: Identical captured production SSR document and asset URLs for both eXact variants. Historical browser modules substituted at Vite load. Assertions verify all six modules were loaded and current transpilation matches installed JavaScript. Current bundle is byte-identical to the production build.
methodology.cache: Fresh browser context per sample, network cache disabled. One Chromium process per population.
methodology.correctness: Every navigation waits for Live service, claims the incident, waits for Version 2, and rejects browser errors. Large DOM probes compare node identity or form snapshots before timing.
methodology.profiles: 12 separate traced samples per variant after six warmup rounds. Trace durations may overlap and are not additive. Before/after-load classifications exclude spanning events. Module evaluation is reported separately from the shared trace classifier.
methodology.large: Chromium operation microbenchmarks. 60 alternating batches of 20 calls after 20 paired warmups. 1000 authored siblings, 2000 input/textarea controls, and 500 sibling slots. Fixtures built outside timed loops.
limits: Local diagnostic variants, not independently rebuilt historical applications. Compiler, dependencies, SSR, and all unrelated runtime modules held fixed.
Load event timing excludes semantic readiness and live SSR cost. Ready timestamps include browser automation observation delay.
P99 uses the third-largest of 204 measurements. Small timing differences remain sensitive to host variation.
Large DOM probes measure affected operations, not full-page hydration. Dense framework ranges and 2000 dirty controls are stress cases.
Form-only setup runs were excluded after discovering the separate DOM browser build.

methodology.order: All six permutations of normal, deferred, and Svelte repeat in balanced order. Second population swaps the eXact replay ports.
methodology.delivery: Production SSR capture/replay through the common Node HTTP server on native loopback. Identical current bundle and asset URLs. Only the module script tag is replaced with an inline load listener calling import(). No module preload is present.
methodology.cache: Fresh Chromium context per sample with network cache disabled. Same Chromium process within each population.
methodology.ready: MutationObserver timestamp when .connection first contains Live service. This measures scenario readiness, including its service connection.
methodology.correctness: All timed samples complete the claim action and show Version 2 without browser errors. Deferred resource timing verifies the bundle request begins no earlier than loadEventStart.
methodology.earlyInteraction: Separate diagnostic holds the deferred script request until after clicking the SSR Claim incident button. Normal variant clicks after load without holding the script. Both must work once ready.
limits: Local diagnostic only. No framework behavior or application loading policy changed.
Two normal-loading samples in the first population lacked FCP at collection. FCP summaries use observed values and retain their sample counts. Navigation and readiness contain all samples.
Cold local-loopback measurements do not establish warm-cache or CDN results.
Moving script loading beyond load changes what navigation timing includes. FCP and readiness remain independent outcomes.
P99 is the third-largest observation in each population.
Early-click diagnostic deliberately extends the unloaded interval and is not a measurement of its usual duration.

source.variant: HTML-only after-load import diagnostic. Compiled JavaScript unchanged.
